title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium Arena on 1981-12-30
lineage: Transfer: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A (Dolby-B in) > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 11/2019
source: Source: BeyerDynamic M88's > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell XLII-S 90's, recording by Rip Tompkins, & with thanks to Richie Stankiewicz!

ai_review.summary: Positive vibe with a golden‑era feel and enthusiastic crowd, but recording details are unclear
ai_review.review: The lone reviewer paints a picture of a warm, community‑filled night – “golden era” Jerry onstage, Brent at the keys, Bill handing out soup and bread – and rates it five stars. No concrete comments about sound quality or specific song performances were provided, leaving the technical side of the recording ambiguous.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one enthusiastic review; strong positive sentiment for the show but no concrete information on audio quality, so rating leans on general enthusiasm.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer does not mention soundboard, audience mix, clarity, or any technical issues; therefore recording quality cannot be assessed beyond a neutral “fair” estimate.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific set‑list comments; reviewer focuses on atmosphere rather than musical flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as part of a “golden era” performance, indicating strong appreciation.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboardist) noted as present and contributing to the vibe.
